from pathlib import Path
from zipfile import ZipFile, ZIP_DEFLATED

root = Path('.').resolve()
git = root / '.git'
out = root / 'git-directory.zip'

if not git.is_dir():
    raise SystemExit('No .git directory found in project root')

with ZipFile(out, 'w', ZIP_DEFLATED) as z:
    for p in git.rglob('*'):
        if p.is_file() or p.is_symlink():
            z.write(p, p.relative_to(root).as_posix())
        elif p.is_dir():
            # Preserve empty directories if any
            rel = p.relative_to(root).as_posix().rstrip('/') + '/'
            z.writestr(rel, b'')

print(out)

from pathlib import Path
from zipfile import ZipFile, ZIP_DEFLATED

root = Path('.').resolve()
out = root / 'git-directory.zip'
config = root / '.git' / 'config'

if not config.is_file():
    raise SystemExit('No .git/config file found in project root')

if not out.exists():
    raise SystemExit('git-directory.zip does not exist')

with ZipFile(out, 'a', ZIP_DEFLATED) as z:
    names = set(z.namelist())
    if '.git/config' not in names:
        z.write(config, '.git/config')
        print('Added .git/config to archive')
    else:
        print('.git/config is already included in archive')

with ZipFile(out) as z:
    info = z.getinfo('.git/config')
    print(f'.git/config size: {info.file_size} bytes')
